mentions.name: Valdres
mentions.description: A JavaScript state management library designed to be faster than Jotai and Recoil, batteries included, with advanced features such as scopes and indexes. Version 1.0 is in beta and it is described as "human built, AI finished".
mentions.problem: Existing JS state management libraries like Jotai and Recoil are slower and lack advanced features such as scopes and indexes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working to finish my JS state library: Valdres. Built to be faster than Jotai/Recoil, batteries included, and more advanced features like scopes, indexes and more. It’s “human built, AI finished”. 1.0 is in beta. https://valdres.dev
